# Sprint 1 data fixtures (DO NOT EDIT)

Generated by the Sprint 1 code (commit `21c5582`, ImageSpec `0.1.0`, catalog `prompter.core@0.2.0`,
compiler `0.2.0`) before any Sprint 2-A change. Used to prove lossless migration and Basic prompt
regression in later versions.

- `export-full.json` — every Basic Composer attribute set
- `export-inactive.json` — Korean free text + an inapplicable (kept) framing selection
- `localstorage-workspace.txt` — raw `prompter:v1:workspace` value of `export-full`
- `expected-prompts.json` — the exact prompts Sprint 1 produced for the two specs
